turns.prompt:
You are given two attached CSV files describing perovskite solar cells as
complete devices — `substrate` (glass + transparent electrode), `etl`
(electron-transport layer stack), `htl` (hole-transport layer stack),
`backcontact` (metal / carbon back electrode), `deposition` (absorber
deposition procedure; `>>` separates steps). Every candidate below uses the
same MAPbI3 absorber in the same n-i-p (regular) architecture; they differ
only in the remaining columns. Each row is a device CONFIGURATION whose
efficiency is the median over at least 3 independently fabricated cells, so
it is a reproducible recipe rather than a single champion cell:
  - b3_pvk_stack_train.csv: 300 configurations with the measured power
    conversion efficiency (%).
  - b3_pvk_stack_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE configurations whose power
    conversion efficiency (%) was NOT measured, columns `candidate_id` and
    the same device columns.

Using the training data, select the 5 candidates with the HIGHEST power
conversion efficiency (%).

Reason from the device physics — band alignment and selectivity of the
transport layers, interface recombination, contact chemistry and the film
quality the process is likely to give — then end your answer with an
explicit ranked list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902,
c903, c904, c905".
turns.answer_text:
I prioritized candidates that are close to the highest-performing training recipes and that preserve the key physics: a compact TiO2/SnO2 or fullerene-modified ETL for good electron extraction and low interface recombination, a selective HTL such as Spiro-MeOTAD/PTAA/doped triarylamine stacks, an Au/MoO3-type back contact with favorable work function, and spin/co-evaporation processes that tend to give dense, uniform MAPbI3 films. I down-weighted flexible PEN/PET substrates, carbon/no-HTL monolithic contacts, ZnO-only ETLs, and untested exotic HTLs.

Most promising are:
- **c064**: nearly the champion ETL motif `TiO2-c | SnO2-np` with Spiro/Au; SnO2 passivates TiO2 and improves band alignment.
- **c005**: `TiO2-c | PCBM-60` with MoO3/Au, very close to a 19%+ training stack; fullerene passivation plus good hole contact.
- **c068**: SnO2/TiO2 nanoparticle ETL with PTAA and Au/MoO3; resembles high-PTAA/SnO2 devices around 18%.
- **c017**: vacuum co-evaporated fullerene/doped-TaTm stack, close to a 17.9% training device; excellent film quality and selective contacts.
- **c073**: TiO2-c/C60 with PTAA/Ag and HMDS-treated ITO scaffold; C60 passivation and PTAA give a strong, low-recombination junction.

Final: c064, c005, c068, c017, c073
